balls.text: full, middle and leg, driven to the left of long-on where van der Merwe's dive keeps them to two
looking to pull this to midwicket, but gets a single to extra cover. Again the extra pace
short of a length, beats Bravo's pull for the pace. Concedes just the single
short of a length, pulled away over square leg, Botha makes a diving save to keep them down to three
yorker, on off, dug out back to him
short of a length, mis-hits it towards deep midwicket
full, on the toes, helicoptered to wide long-on for two
full toss, on off, driven to long-off for one
short of a length, wide, cut away past point for four more
slower ball, wide outside off. Dhoni swings so hard at it he has turned 180 degrees and is showing his backside to the bowler by the time he finishes the shot. Single to long-off
another yorker tries, but it turns out to a full toss wide outside off. Dhoni has cut this over over point for four
Nehra misses the yorker. Bowls a low full toss. Dhoni crashes this over long-on
slower ball, outside off, driven over point, gets a couple
short, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
new balls please. Slower ball, on a length, outside off, Dhoni has dismissed this out of his presence, and over the roof. Down long-on
Bravo walks down, pulls, but doesn't connect well. Gets a single to midwicket
slower ball, short of a length, pushed straight to extra cover
short of a length, Dhoni pulls, doesn't get all of it, but the ball bounces in front of deep midwicket
that's through before his bat comes down. Full at 140ks, Jadeja slogs, is beaten by pace, and the off stump takes a beating
slower ball, short of a length, punched to extra cover
yorker, middle and leg, dug out towards cover for one
full toss, on off, pushed to extra cover for one
on a length, on the pads, clipped away
on a length, driven with an open face, past point, and without slipping while turning around he gets a second
short of a length, on the pads, dropped into the leg side, and once again wills that one into becoming two
yorker, middle and leg, pushed towards long-on, with soft hands, and he rushes back for two
short of a length, outisde off, he knows the third man is up, and he has late-cut this past that man
slower ball, on a length, Dhoni gets under it, and sends it sailing over cow corner
short of a length, wide, cut away to third man for one
on a length, pitched outside leg, beats his loft. Goes for a leg-bye
short of a length, on off, pushed past cover for one
tossed up, on off, drilled to long-on for one
full, too full, Dhoni can't get under this attempted loft, and gets a single to long-on along the ground
quick, on a length, on off, pushed to cover
flighted outside off, driven to long-off
another wide down the leg side, but this time Jadeja uses the pace of the quick delivery and sweeps it wide of short fine leg
wide outside leg
slower ball, on a off, opens the face to guide it to third man
straight drive from Jadeja, lofted straight of long-on
return catch dropped. Another slower ball, wide outside off, it comes back off the toe end, boot high, but it has come considerably slower than he expects it to. It dips on him too
slower ball, dabbed away to third man for one
short of a length, outside off, pushed to cover
slower short ball, Dhoni is early into the pull, and is hit on the glove
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
down the wicket, Jadeja mis-hits this towards long-off
pushed to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
on a length, defended off the back foot
short of a length, on the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, outside off, left alone. In between Dhoni is practising for South Africa later this year
six time. On a length, on off, he just stands tall with his front leg slightly open and lofts this over long-on
short of a length, on off, punched down to long-on
short of a length, wide, punched away to deep cover
length ball, into the pads, worked away for one
short, wide, asking to be hit. he hits, wide of deep cover for two
full, middle and leg, pushed into the leg side, between deep midwicket and deep square leg. Comes back for the second
short of a length, middle and off, worked to leg for one
soft dismissal. Drives straight into extra cover's lap. Delhi must be telling Irfan Pathan, "What an idea sirji." But for Irfan's overthrow Raina wouldn't even be facing this delivery
down the wicket to push at it. Gets a single to Irfan, but the overthrow gets them a second too
fired across him, beats the outside edge on the dab
length ball outside off, pushed past cover
pulled away to deep midwicket
on a length, on off, Dhoni defends off the back foot
short of a length, gets it to rise towards the chest. Dhoni is on his toes to fend
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man
sharp bouncer. Hussey is late into the pull, top-edges this from shoulder high, lobs this over short fine leg. Sehwag goes back to catch it
Finally Jadhav catches one, and appeals, but Hussey hasn't edged this one
short of a length, punched straight to straight cover
Botha seems to be struggling with the dew here. Down leg this goes
sweeps away from in front of off, the ball goes off the inside half of the bat
into the pads, worked away for one
flighted outside off, driven to deep cover
short of a length, outside off, punched to long-off
tossed up outside off, driven to deep cover
short of a length, wide, Raina goes to punch at it, and is beaten
short of a length, angling into the pads, worked away past square leg
short of a length, outside off, Raina looks to punch, is beaten on the inside edge
wide down the leg side. Not given. Seems to have touched the pad on the way
finally the run-out. Hussey is cramped for room, the ball rolls towards point, they want a single, but Rohrer swoops in, and flicks it onto the stumps even while diving
length ball, into the pads, defended to midwicket
clipped away off the pads, wide of deep square
half-volley outside off, driven between the bowler and mid-off

Missed run-out. Slower ball, pushed past point, he comes back for a second that he looks like he will make, but his bat gets stuck in the turf. Jadhav, though, doesn't even break the wicket and is not even awake to what has happened to Vijay's bat
length ball, outside off, defended
Kedar Jadhav is having a shocker. Wide down the leg side, and he doesn't even make an attempt to go after it
length ball, middle and leg, slower ball, worked into the leg side
length ball, middle and leg, gets an inside edge onto the pad
Vijay loves the offbreaks. He charges at him again, and lofts him way over long-on fort a six
superb shot. Charges him makes room too, takes this on the half-volley, and drives it between mid-off and extra cover
driven to long-off
down the wicket, makes room, and drives it past extra cover
slower through the air. Drops at his feet and runs
driven straight to mid-on but they steal a single
angling into the pads once too often, but this time Vijay has clipped this fine of fine leg for four
driven down the ground, but Warner makes a diving save at mid-off
short of a length, wide, punched away to cover-point
worked away off the pads
going down the leg side, clips the pad on the way
short of a length, angling in, it goes off the inside half of the bat for a couple
smashed down the ground. Down the wicket to Pathan again, and even though he has got too close to the ball he manages to hit it between the bowler and mid-on
Hussey charges at Pathan again, and gets under a length ball to loft it over extra cover for four
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point with an open face
down the wicket and has a wild heave at it, but is beaten by the away movement
swinging down the leg side again, Vijay is beaten, but gets a leg-bye
swinging in from just short of a length, hits Vijay on the pad, but this is headed down leg
runs this past the keeper for a single
dropped by Jadhav. This one seams away from short of a length, takes the edge, goes low to Jadhav's right, but he is a bit lazy in going for it
short of a length, into the pads, pushed away into the leg side
short of a length, wide, cut away, but finds cover-point
short of a length, on off, defended to cover
length ball outside off, beats the outside edge as it holds its line
on a length, middle and leg, clipped away past square leg
bouncer, mis-hit past square leg for two
Hussey tries the pull, but the ball is not short enough and skids under the bat
pushed on the up, past the diving short cover, gets a single
short of a length, wide, pushed to point
on a length, middle and off, watchfully played back
on a length, accurate, defended back to him
wide down the leg side
short of a length, middle and off, pushed wide of mid-on for one
wide half-volley, driven away nicely, but can't beat the cover-point, who is on the circle
swinging in, beats Vijay's flick, but the ball is headed down leg
short of a length, outside off, pushed to cover
on a length, on the pads, nicely clipped away past square leg
slower ball, driven between long-on and deep midwicket
gets a thick outside edge on the attempted big drive. Wide of the keeper
slower ball, outside off, beats the bat again
slower ball, beats his drive outside off
full, on off, dug out
I wish I could say this is left alone outside off, but he has had an almighty slog at this delicate juncture. Beaten
nearly a yorker, dug out wide of third man, takes a couple, and hands over the strike to Yadav
dipping slow full toss. Played out for one to point
slower ball, Kaul edges it to third man for one
full toss, driven to deep cover for one
short, slower ball, on the stumps, Kaul sways out of its line
slower ball, on a length, middle and leg, defended
full and straight. It took all the defensive fortitude of Kaul to keep this out
Bravo on a hat-trick. Slower ball, outside off, Nehra slogs, gets a big edge. Dhoni gets under it
yorker, goes past the outside edge of Pathan, who is backing away. For a change, no dance from Bravo
driven to deep cover
clipped away of the pads
full, on off, driven to long-off for one
full outside off, squeezed out to third man
Yadav has not read the team orders. He has actually taken a length ball and smashed it over long-on for six when all he just needs to do is bat out three overs for a draw
full, outside off, defended to cover
lenght ball, on the pads, Warner has found deep square leg with precision. Sums up their season really
full, outside leg, no room. Clipped away for one
he tries to follow Bravo who is backing away, and concedes a leg-side wide
he has premeditated the switch hit, and wasted a full toss by smashing it wide of long-on for just two
slower ball, Warner has mis-hit this to long-on for one
slower ball, Bravo dives across the width of the pitch, but can't get a touch on the ball
yorker, on off. Warner goes deep into the crease to try to place it past point, but finds the man
down the wicket to drive this to the left of long-off for two
full, on the pads, worked away off the toes
switch-block. Warner turns right-handed, but gets no room, and ends up blocking this towards long-on
offbreak, punched to long-on
I think Ashwin tried a doosra here. Not the carrom ball. But the doosra. And sure enough it didn;t spin from off to leg, and van der Merwe ended up skying the big hit to Raina at long-on
punched down to long-off for one
really slow through the air, van der Merwe has the time to go back and pull
gets a top edge on the cut, but it doesn't carry to short third man
short, pulled away to deep square leg
wide half-volley, he gets under it, drives inside-out over cover for four
slower ball, nearly a yorker again, dug out to point
full, nearly a yorker, dug out to his left
driven to long-on for one
driven back to Holder
down the wicket, gets a high full toss, which is hit straight to long-off, and Warner comes back for two. The throw is on a half-volley, which is why Dhoni can't collect it
cut away. Gets a single to deep point
flat offbreak, worked around the corner
Raina nearly pulls off a blinder. This is slogged towards deep midwicket, Raina attacks the ball, charges in full pelt, puts the dive in, but gets to it only on the half-volley
short of a length, punched away to deep cover
the carrom ball. He reads it off the pitch, punches it to deep cover
short of a length, angling in, pulled away for one
tries to slog one out of the ground, but gets just the single off the inside half of the at
short of a length, angling in, pushed for one
slower ball, full, drilled to long-on for one
Warner opens up. Slower ball, on a length, on the pads, he has swept this over square leg for six
short of a length, mis-hits the punch, gets a single
slower ball, kicks away, and beats the outside edge on the pull
slower ball, full, pushed to long-on
on a length, on off, pushed to cover
short of a length again, into the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, into the pads, goes off the thigh pad for four leg-byes
slower ball, on the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, slower ball, defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off, beaten on the attempt to late-cut it
slower short ball, he covers it, runs it down, fine of third man for two
diving save at point from Badri saves four
oh what a soft dismissal. Short of a length, on the pads, and he has nicely flicked this straight down square leg's throat
slower ball, wide down the leg side
yorker, on off, dug out to cover
length ball, outside off, driven wide of third man for two
pushed into the leg side for another single. Another 11 overs to survive for a draw
short, wide, cut away to deep cover
short of a length, on off, cut to cover
stays back to defend a length ball
angling into the pads, worked away for one
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on for one

Jadhav's horror night ends. He has dropped, missed a run-out, and has now got out trying a crazy predetermined shot. Gets inside the line to pull, the ball is not nearly short enough, and he gloves it through to Dhoni who makes no mistake
length ball, outside leg, worked away to deep midwicket
length ball, on off, pushed past cover for one
short of a length, no room, pushed into the leg side for one
short of a length, on off, dabbed away to third man
short of a length, on the pads, worked away
on a length, on off, defended to leg
pulled away. Not too short, and hence he mis-hits this, but it doesn't carry to deep midwicket
wide down the leg side. That breaks the maiden
on a length, topspinner, defended off the back page
top-edges a sweep from just outside off, straight to fine leg. Offspinner to offspinner. We are left with one offspinner
straighter one, beats the drive
offbreak. Would have been wide had he not bottom-edged this cut
mid-off is up, which is why Warner plays this shortish ball in the air on the off side. Clears the man with ease
flicked away off the toes for one
short of a length, tucked off the hip for one
Warner slogs at a length ball, gets a healthy inside edge. Four for him
short of a lenght, angling in, helped around the corner
Botha has swept Holder from wide outside off for a four through fine leg. Need more be said about this shot
short of a length, angling in, defended back to him
defended towards mid-off
and had he taken the single last ball, Chand would have been chilling at the non-striker's end instead of getting out to a slower ball. He has not picked it, and has got a top edge on the slog-sweep

Chand is caught sleeping. Played to short third man, Botha makes the call, but Chand doesn't respond at all. Botha has enough time to come back, but Chand doesn't move at all. It was Botha's call. Chand should have responded to it
full, nearly a yorker, the knowledgeable Chennai crowd goes up for a bump ball
pulled over long-on. Not too short, but he does play this shot well off the front foot
length ball, outside off, the mid-off is wide, and Botha has driven it for four
short of a length, outside off, seaming back in, defended to cover
this one is ion Botha's slot. Fuller than the previous balls, he plants the front foot down, and slogs it over midwicket
swing away after it is pitched short of a length and outside off. Beats the edge
mis-hits the pull, but takes a single to short fine leg thanks to a fumble from Jadeja
short of a length, angling in, defended in front of off
full, outside off, this one holds its line, and beats Botha's attempted straight drive
short of a length, seams back in a little. Botha defends in front of off
full, wide, driven to third man with an open face
length ball, on off, pushed to cover
bouncer, 137ks, on off, Chand wants to ramp it, but is beaten
manufactures a pull off the front foot. Because this is not short enough, he ends up sending this over mid-on
pulled off the front foot, past square leg, for four
short of a length, outside off, pushed straight to cover-point
wide length ball, flies off the outside half of the bat, over point
goes back to play this, but can't beat point
punched to cover
short of a length, outside off, Botha stays inside the line of it
short of a length, wide, Chand's back foot goes across to get closer to the line of the ball, and he cuts it wide of point for four
bouncer, good one too. Oh, replays show it is slightly over the head. Called wide. That was sharp, though
length ball, outside off, defended with an open face
pushed to the rigth of mid-off. Delhi and Botha off the mark
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
Sehwag gone for a duck. Short, wide, Sehwag goes to cut it, but the ball seams away a little and takes the toe end of the bat through to the keeper
short of a length, on off, punched to mid-off
